import urllib.request
import os

url = ''https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/download/v2.1.131/claude-linux-x64.tar.gz''
output = ''claude-linux-x64.tar.gz''

# Try to resume download
existing_size = os.path.exists\(output\) and os.path.getsize\(output\) or 0
print\(f''Existing size: {existing_size}''\)

req = urllib.request.Request\(url, headers={''Range'': f''bytes={existing_size}-''} if existing_size else {}\)
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen\(req, timeout=30\) as response:
        total = int\(response.headers.get\(''Content-Length'', 0\)\) + existing_size
        print\(f''Total size: {total}''\)
        with open\(output, ''ab'' if existing_size else ''wb''\) as f:
            downloaded = existing_size
            while True:
                chunk = response.read\(1024*1024\)  # 1MB chunks
                if not chunk:
                    break
                f.write\(chunk\)
                downloaded += len\(chunk\)
                print\(f''Downloaded: {downloaded}/{total} \({100*downloaded/total:.1f}%\)'', end=''\\r''\)
        print\(\)
except Exception as e:
    print\(f''Error: {e}''\)
")
